question: Can deployable single official checkpoints cover errors missed by the recommended bearing output, and can actual reference feedback identify the right one before service? This is development evidence, no new-device independence claim.
initial_audit: Use the recommended output, plus exact native weight files for training median, training mean, teacher-ridge readout, whole-teacher hidden splits and the unchanged root. Audit against previously published outputs and answer IDs from official validation (one original service assignment and all six assignments, repeat service samples across assignments counted explicitly), three XJTU fifth units, PRONOSTIA, KAIST and IMS. Also record known independently fitted phase tree as stronger non-native single-model control. Per site: aggregate RMSE, by physical device, squared bias versus within-device residual variance, fixed method with lowest aggregate error, hindsight per-device native-method oracle, and rows improved/harmed. Never use these oracle choices online.
maintenance: Run target-blind replay on official all role assignments with the existing explored/adoption label clock, and at synchronized starts on separate XJTU and PRONOSTIA reference bearings, using five actual rows per completed reference, strictly later than its endpoint. Shared menu is root, median, mean, readout, hidden. Start at root in all adaptive arms. Compare strongest fixed, first informed pick, current historical equal-device MSE selection, and minimax relative regret (candidate squared error minus the best on each historical reference, divided by max root MSE on that reference or 1 square minute; choose smallest maximum, ties incumbency then list order). With two disjoint official labeled devices, first confirm choices across both; scores per group, report where reference devices agree with or oppose service optimal choice. Hindsight cannot drive choice. No more than one released weight per round, no new training, equal available menu/inputs for fixed and autonomous groups, track actual fits from construction separately. Compare to existing Self-Healing ML adapted service receipts where the rows match. No paper score for a new clock without a matched run.
gate: For candidate to change recommendation: >=1% lower RMSE than recommended and best fixed single checkpoint on both official (original plus 6-role pooled audited separately) and separated XJTU and PRONOSTIA service sets, worst-device increase <=1% versus same controls. Respect official single-checkpoint interface. Report fixed phase-tree results alongside. Failure ends this specific bank/selection rule; identify whether information or the candidates actually limit the result.
